nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression was used to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes based on age and sex.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes (GMVs) based on age and sex in HCs.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional gray matter volumes (246 regions) were used as the response variable.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes (GMVs)... resulting in a Z-score vector (246 × 1) for each patient
